answer: Social Matters >> Nikah (Marriage) Question ID: 51308 Country: India Title: Nikah During Periods? Question: Is nikah valid if the dulhan (bride) is menstruating on the day of nikah? Is it necessary to be paak while doing Ijaab-o-Qabool in front of a wakil? Answer ID: 51308 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 450/450/M=04/1435) Nikah is valid even in the state of menstruation. Paaki (to be clean and pure) is not necessary for nikah. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
